map.mockNote: Other avatars on the map are playground mock data and will be replaced by real check-ins once EPIC 3 connects the backend.
map.denied: No location access — showing all of Hong Kong. The map still works.
map.outside: You are outside Hong Kong — showing all of Hong Kong instead.

map.cheersSent: Sent! Redeem it next time you meet!
map.selfHint: Tap below for a fated pick and drop a “want” pin.
map.tilesFallback: The watercolor basemap needs a Stadia key; showing the fallback until it is set (restart after adding).
map.overlayTitle: Location is needed for the map
map.stepOsIos: iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services: master switch on
map.stepAppChromeIos: Settings → Chrome → Location: While Using the App
map.stepInApp: You are in an in-app browser (WeChat/IG etc.) which blocks location — copy the link into Safari/Chrome
map.stepRetryBack: Come back and tap Retry locate
map.deniedGuide: Usually a past denial or location turned off system-wide. Check in order: 1) OS master switch: iPhone Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services on; Android Settings → Location on. 2) Browser site permission: Chrome lock icon → Location → Allow. 3) Opened inside WeChat/IG? Reopen this link in Safari/Chrome.
